meta.agency: Colorado Department of Local Affairs: Division of Housing (State Housing Board), plus Division of Local Government grants for housing projects
meta.method: Read by hand from State Housing Board vote summaries in the board packets, DOLA and Governor's office releases, the Division of Housing "Application Schedule and Awards" tables, its annual reports to the legislature (FY2023-24, FY2024-25), and three news reports standing in for deleted DOLA releases. Each quote was compared with the downloaded source text. A project reported by more than one source is kept once, from the most official source with an amount (vote summary, then release, then DOH table, then annual report, then news). Private Activity Bond allocations are bond cap, not funding, and are left out. Eight southwest awards added 2026-10-30 (Residences at Durango, Mancos Commons, and six Division of Local Government grants) were read through a web reader because the DOLA sites block a saved download; their notes say so.
meta.coverage: Every Division of Housing award from July 2021 on, from DOH's annual reports (FY2021-22 to FY2024-25) and, for later months, State Housing Board vote summaries, DOLA releases and DOH award tables. Awards before July 2021 are not included. An announcement that names fewer awards than its total is marked complete: false, and its awards are marked unconfirmed.
meta.county_note: county_fips is the county as printed, else the county of the printed town when the town lies wholly in one county (data/hna/cross-county-places.json lists the ones that do not); otherwise null and the award is listed but not mapped.
